kv8.2:1.15: Kāmabhavassa ca rūpabhavassa ca antare atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:1.19: Rūpabhavassa ca arūpabhavassa ca antare atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:2.1: Kāmabhavassa ca rūpabhavassa ca antare n' atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:2.3: Hañci kāmabhavassa ca rūpabhavassa ca antare n' atthi antarābhavo, no vata re vattabbe
kv8.2:2.5: Rūpabhavassa ca arūpabhavassa ca antare n' atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:2.7: Hañci rūpabhavassa ca arūpabhavassa ca antare n' atthi antarābhavo, no vata re vattabbe
kv8.2:3.3: Pañcamī sā yoni, chaṭṭhamī sā gati, aṭṭhamī sā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, dasamo so sattāvāso ti?
kv8.2:3.7: Antarābhavo bhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni viññāṇaṭṭhiti attabhāvapaṭilābho ti?
kv8.2:3.13: Antarābhave sattā jāyanti, jīyanti, mīyanti, cavanti, uppajjantīti?
kv8.2:3.15: Antarābhave atthi rūpaṃ vedanā saññā saṃkhārā viññāṇan ti?
kv8.2:4.1: Atthi kāmabhavo, kāmabhavo bhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni viññāṇaṭṭhiti attabhāvapaṭilābho ti?
kv8.2:4.3: Atthi antarābhavo, antarābhavo bhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni viññāṇaṭṭhiti attabhāvapaṭilābho ti?
kv8.2:4.13: Kāmabhave sattā jāyanti jīyanti mīyanti cavanti uppajjantīti?
kv8.2:4.15: Antarābhave sattā jāyanti jīyanti mīyanti cavanti uppajjantīti?
kv8.2:4.17: Kāmabhave atthi rūpaṃ vedanā saññā saṃkhārā viññāṇan ti?
kv8.2:4.19: Antarābhave atthi rūpaṃ vedanā saññā saṃkhārā viññāṇan ti?
kv8.2:5.1: Atthi rūpabhavo, rūpabhavo bhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni viññāṇaṭṭhiti attabhāvapaṭilābho ti?
kv8.2:5.3: Atthi antarābhavo, antarābhavo bhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni viññāṇaṭṭhiti attabhāvapaṭilābho ti?
kv8.2:5.13: Rūpabhave sattā jāyanti jīyanti mīyanti cavanti uppajjantīti?
kv8.2:5.15: Antarābhave sattā jāyanti jīyanti mīyanti cavanti uppajjantīti?
kv8.2:5.17: Rūpabhave atthi rūpaṃ vedanā saññā saṃkhārā viññāṇan ti?
kv8.2:5.19: Antarābhave atthi rūpaṃ vedanā saññā saṃkhārā viññāṇan ti?
kv8.2:6.1: Atthi arūpabhavo, arūpabhavo bhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni viññāṇaṭṭhiti attabhāvapaṭilābho ti?
kv8.2:6.3: Atthi antarābhavo, antarābhavo bhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni viññāṇaṭṭhiti attabhāvapaṭilābho ti?
kv8.2:6.13: Arūpabhave sattā jāyanti jīyanti mīyanti cavanti uppajjantīti?
kv8.2:6.15: Antarābhave sattā jāyanti jīyanti mīyanti cavanti uppajjantīti?
kv8.2:6.17: Arūpabhave atthi vedanā saññā saṃkhārā viññāṇan ti?
kv8.2:6.19: Antarābhave atthi vedanā saññā saṃkhārā viññāṇan ti?
kv8.2:7.3: Sabbesañ ñeva sattānaṃ atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:7.5: Sabbesañ ñeva sattānaṃ n' atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:7.7: Hañci sabbesañ ñeva sattānaṃ n' atthi antarābhavo, no vata re vattabbe
kv8.2:8.5: Ānantarikassa puggalassa n' atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:8.7: Hañci ānantarikassa puggalassa n' atthi antarābhavo, no vata re vattabbe
kv8.2:9.5: Ānantarikassa puggalassa n' atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:9.7: Na-ānantarikassa puggalassa n' atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:9.13: Arūpūpagassa puggalassa n' atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:9.15: Hañci arūpūpagassa puggalassa n' atthi antarābhavo, no vata re vattabbe
kv8.2:10.5: Arūpūpagassa puggalassa n' atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:10.7: Na-arūpūpagassa puggalassa n' atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:11.5: Hañci antarāparinibbāyī puggalo atthi, tena vata re vattabbe
kv8.2:12.1: Antarāparinibbāyī puggalo atthīti katvā atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:12.3: Upahaccaparinibbāyī puggalo atthīti katvā atthi upahaccabhavo ti?
kv8.2:12.5: Antarāparinibbāyī puggalo atthīti katvā atthi antarābhavo ti?
kv8.2:12.8: sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī puggalo atthīti katvā atthi sasaṃkhārabhavo ti?
